statement: let I := fun n : ℕ => Finset.Icc ((n+2)/3) ((2*n)/3); let P := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 2 z).filter Nat.Prime; let V := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).card:ℝ)*(n.totient:ℝ)/n * ∏ p ∈ (P z).filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ n), (1-2/(p:ℝ)); let S := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).filter (fun u => u.Coprime n ∧ z < (u*(n-u)).minFac)).card; let Z₀ := fun n U : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/(U:ℝ))⌋₊; let Z₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let Z₂ := Nat.sqrt; (∃ N₁ : ℕ, 64 ≤ N₁ ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N₁ ≤ n → Even n → V n (Z₁ n) - V n n.sqrt / 8 ≤ (S n (Z₁ n):ℝ)) → (∃ U₁ : ℕ, 8 ≤ U₁ ∧ ∀ U : ℕ, U₁ ≤ U → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 64 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → Even n → let L := ((I n).filter (fun u => u.Coprime n ∧ Z₀ n U < (u*(n-u)).minFac ∧ (u*(n-u)).minFac ≤ Z₁ n)).card; (L:ℝ) ≤ V n (Z₀ n U) - V n (Z₁ n) + V n (Z₂ n)/4)

plain_statement.zh: 归约：给定中段下界筛，结合小 cutoff 上界与两筛差即得冻结的中段目标。
plain_statement.en: Reduction: the middle lower-bound sieve together with the small-cutoff upper bound and the sift difference implies the frozen middle target.
